about: Each commentator's entry in Wikidata and English Wikipedia, for the sameAs links in Logia's schema.org data. Written by scripts/fetch_wikidata.py, which accepts an entry only when Wikidata says the person is human and gives the same year of death as library/authors/; never typed. Under "works", each work of the early church's Wikidata item and its number in the Clavis Patrum Graecorum or Latinorum, accepted only when the item's author is the commentator's item and its label clearly matches the work's title.
